description: This file implements the KmlLocationsHandler class, which processes KML location data, parses it, and sends GPS location updates via a GnssClient. It handles incoming messages, parses location points, and communicates with a GNSS service.

classes.name: KmlLocationsHandler
classes.description: Handles KML location messages, parses location data, and communicates with GNSS service.

methods.name: KmlLocationsHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a callback to send data to the client.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming message, parses KML data, and sends GPS locations to the GNSS client.
